target_customer: Companies that want to hire AI employees for roles such as ML engineer, analyst, account executive or paralegal
problem: Teams lack ML and analyst capacity; Jarmin offers AI employees that learn a role, embed in company systems and take over tasks or whole initiatives.
business_model: Per-role AI employee subscription plus managed AI and ML engineering services

founders.name: Chalmers Brown
education: Rutgers University, Computer Science and Pre-Med
previous_startups: Techstars founder (as listed on YC page, outcome not stated)

founders.name: Shir Halder
education: Carnegie Mellon University, CS and Robotics
founders.background_notes: YC page lists CVPR best paper and other ML papers. RoundFunded spells the name Shirsendu Halder.

founders.name: Zack Leman
education: Tuck School of Business, Business Bridge Program
previous_startups: (catch) health (CTO and co-founder, outcome not stated)

competitors.name: Artisan
competitors.what: AI employees, starting with outbound sales agent Ava
competitors.funding_then: $7.3M seed (May 2024), later a $25M Series A per the company blog (April 2025)

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that handle multi-step ML and analyst work reliably inside customer systems are hard, though built on third party models; the team has Meta, Apple and AWS ML experience.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded AI employee startups existed and nothing public shows proprietary data or deep integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General agent platforms from model vendors expanded through 2025 and 2026; no direct action on Jarmin found.

market_need_then: Demand for AI employees in 2024 and 2025 was shown by Artisan's rounds and the broad enterprise agent push; Jarmin's own demand evidence is not public.

identity.voice_and_tone: Role-based, hire-an-employee framing ('Hire AI ML Engineers...')

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand pages found; name is similar to Jarvie, Jimini and other AI names.

outcome_analysis: Jarmin is an Active Fall 2025 company with a strong ML founding team but no public traction, customers or priced round. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. It competes in the crowded AI employee category where Artisan raised first and model vendors expand into agents.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (VCBacked, Standout, Premier Alts) list about $500K, labelled pre-seed or seed, dated September or December 2025, with YC as the only investor; not recorded as a round. Standout lists Chalmers Brown as an investor, likely an error. The site does not name founders; founders come from the YC page. Completeness pass: the $500K is recorded from VCBacked (labelled pre-seed, dated 2025-09; Everydev calls it seed dated 2025-09-29). Aggregators only, matches the YC standard amount.
